fusions.name: Cold Regard
fusions.desc: Sends a level stare into the first enemy it meets, dealing 11 arcane damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it [Suppressed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Every Gap Counted
fusions.desc: Strikes at each gap you have picked out across a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 28 damage to everything in it and leaving it [Marked] for 8 seconds. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Stare-Down
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 20% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Slit Visor
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%, and your armour rises by 6%.
